strategies.trigger: HTTP 403, blocked, or empty body from web_fetch
strategies.tactic: Escalate one tier: browser_open (Playwright) if available, else one narrow browser_use on a deep-link — never homepage-first
strategies.efficiency_gain: Avoids repeated failed fetches

strategies.trigger: JS-heavy page or cookie wall, little useful text from fetch
strategies.tactic: Use browser_open; dismiss cookies then browser_extract_text
strategies.efficiency_gain: Gets visible content when static fetch fails

strategies.trigger: Enough candidates with sources already collected
strategies.tactic: Stop extra searches; write RESEARCH_COMPLETE report
strategies.efficiency_gain: Prevents context bloat and LLM timeouts

strategies.trigger: Learned URL patterns exist for a host
strategies.tactic: First browser_open on that host must be a search/deep-link URL (path+params from memory, values from task); never site root first
strategies.efficiency_gain: Skips homepage form thrash and cookie walls

strategies.trigger: Two form click/type no-ops on same host
strategies.tactic: Stop UI clicks; one browser_open with a different search URL (query params), not another homepage; then abandon if that fails
strategies.efficiency_gain: URL-param recovery before permanent block

strategies.trigger: Deep-link/search URL returns 404 or empty after patterns were used
strategies.tactic: Brief homepage relearn (few actions only); update url_patterns; do not enter long form loops
strategies.efficiency_gain: Recovers from stale patterns without wasting the session

strategies.trigger: Adding a candidate to the shortlist
strategies.tactic: Always include constraints_check (matched/unmatched/unknown from task hard requirements) so partial matches are explicit
strategies.efficiency_gain: Prevents silent junk shortlist entries

strategies.trigger: After browser_open, final URL query params differ structurally from requested (e.g. date/pax filters rewritten by the site)
strategies.tactic: Do not reopen the same URL. If the page still shows names+prices, shortlist with match_status=partial and honest unmatched/unknown; only leave the host when the page is empty of candidates
strategies.efficiency_gain: Keeps partial deals instead of abandoning a useful list page

strategies.trigger: Phase-1 shortlist is empty after primary sources were tried
strategies.tactic: Skip broad verification phase; document limitations and synthesize
strategies.efficiency_gain: Avoids a second discovery loop with no candidates

strategies.trigger: browser_use timed out or returned error on a host
strategies.tactic: Do not retry browser_use on that host this session; web_fetch any known detail URLs, try another primary source, or RESEARCH_COMPLETE
strategies.efficiency_gain: Prevents 3+ minute repeated timeouts with zero yield

strategies.trigger: Need Browser Use (tier 3) after cheaper tools failed
strategies.tactic: One narrow instruction only: list visible packages OR open one detail page — never filter+list+detail in one call; always pass a deep-link start_url
strategies.efficiency_gain: Raises success rate and keeps sessions under timeout

strategies.trigger: Global site recipe exists for a host (preferred_channel set)
strategies.tactic: Use that channel first on every task that hits this host — do not rediscover from the homepage
strategies.efficiency_gain: Cross-task reuse of transport knowledge

strategies.trigger: Host marked human_setup_needed
strategies.tactic: Skip expensive browser loops; document limitation; operator may add API/deep-link to memory later
strategies.efficiency_gain: Stops burning compute on structurally blocked hosts

strategies.trigger: All automated tiers failed on a host
strategies.tactic: Mark host exhausted for this session; move to next source; learnings are saved globally for the next task
strategies.efficiency_gain: Fail fast and improve the system over runs

strategies.trigger: Param warning: small integer request became a date-like final value
strategies.tactic: That query key is not occupancy/count — stop sending party size there; set travelers via visible UI controls or a different param from patterns
strategies.efficiency_gain: Avoids repeating the same broken deep-link encoding

strategies.trigger: Repeated browser_open with 0 results / no price signals on a host
strategies.tactic: After one empty page, retry once with fewer filters; if still empty, abandon host for this session
strategies.efficiency_gain: Stops inventory thrashing that burns Ollama context

strategies.trigger: Run kind is recon (learning)
strategies.tactic: Never call add_to_shortlist; never rank task candidates. Optimize for interface learning (navigation + semantics + harvest probes), not for finishing a user booking. RESEARCH_COMPLETE = mechanism summary only
strategies.efficiency_gain: Keeps learning runs out of research deliverables

strategies.trigger: Recon: learn a host interface
strategies.tactic: Run small probes (one dimension at a time when possible): destination/date/pax/filter → compare final URL; note ignored/rewritten params; confirm results list shows names+prices. Stop at list/detail — never checkout
strategies.efficiency_gain: Builds reusable capability model instead of one-off trajectories

strategies.trigger: Research: known recipe structurally fails (param rewrite, ignored filter, empty after valid deep-link)
strategies.tactic: Do not rediscover from homepage thrash. Note needs_recon for that host, document limitation, move to next primary source. Full recon is a separate run
strategies.efficiency_gain: Protects research budget; improves next recon pass

strategies.trigger: Recon capability incomplete (navigation ok, semantics or harvest weak)
strategies.tactic: Prefer more probes on missing layer only — do not re-solve navigation. Harvest: open one results page and note where prices/names appear
strategies.efficiency_gain: Fills the gap that caused weak research yields
